notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests + bs4, Chrome UA impersonation) worked for the whole pass - Shopify storefront, robots.txt is a permissive 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only private/transactional paths disallowed (no anthropic-ai/Claude block), so tier (a) was fully sufficient and tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu (desktop nav-drawer DOM, all columns: Rugs, Pillows & Fabric, Furniture, Decor, Art & Mirrors, Lighting, Bedding, Kids, Collaborations) + sitemap_collections_1.xml (529 collection URLs, keyword-scanned for storage/organize/basket/box/shelf/rack/cabinet terms) + each candidate collection page's own filter/product listing. Confirmed the top-nav 'Rugs' link actually resolves to /collections/shop-all-rugs (h1 'Shop All Rugs', canonical matches) - the bare /collections/rugs URL seen on the homepage is a marketing banner/CTA link only (empty client-rendered landing template, no product grid or count in SSR HTML), so shop-all-rugs was used as the real category page instead. QTY: read from the theme's '
N items
' element present in the initial HTML response of every collection page fetched (SSR, not JS-hydrated) - confirmed by cross-checking each page's h1 and canonical URL matched the requested node before recording. baby-swaddles page explicitly renders '0 items' (genuine zero-product listing) so recorded qty=0 rather than skipped. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Wallpaper (paper/vinyl wall covering, not fabric) - shop-all-wallpaper and cait-kids-patterned-wallpaper; Pillow Cover Inserts (pillow-cover-inserts) - inspected contents, actual products are 'Down Feather Inserts' and a full 'White Goose Down Pillow', i.e. filling/stuffing components not fabric goods; all Furniture nodes (Sofas, Accent Chairs, Tables, Beds, Dressers, Nightstands, Dining furniture, Bookcases, etc.); all Lighting nodes (lamps, sconces, chandeliers, pendants, flush mounts incl. Cait Kids lighting); all Decorative Home Accessories nodes (Faux Florals, Candles & Scents, Books, Vases & Jars, Tissue Holders, Bowls & Trays, Picture Frames, Cait Kids Decor, Decorative Boxes/trinket boxes); Art & Mirrors (Wall Decor boundary); Kitchen & Dining (Serveware, Dishware); Toys and Bibs (Cait Kids - not home textile); 'Shop All X' / 'Featured' shortcut duplicate links (Shop All Pillows, Shop All Fabric, Shop All Bedding, Shop All Living Room, Shop All Kids, etc.) where real subcategories already captured, per parent-URL rule; the 'Collected' antiques/vintage line and its 'Collected Storage'/'Collected Pillows' sub-filters (collected-new = 81-item mixed curated collection spanning pillows/fabric/furniture/tableware/art - a marketing collection, not a genuine standing category tree, per View-All/Collections rule); all Caitlin Wilson x [collab] pages (Peacock Alley, Nantucket, Paul Montgomery, Shadow Catchers, Nicola Bathie, Cooper Classics, Atelier Choux) - promotional collab landing pages; single-product micro-collections found only via sitemap and not linked in any live nav (linen-wastebasket, margot-bow-wastebasket-tissue-holder, wedgwood-boxes, atelier-choux-gift-box, decorative-boxes, shelves-cabinets [also 0 products, orphaned/unreachable via current site navigation]); Sale (promotional). STORAGE note: 'Baskets' (storage-baskets) was inspected in full - the 7 listed products are Grace's Garden Waste Basket, Braided Fireplace Basket, Provencial French Basket and 4x Linen Wastebasket color variants; the page's own marketing copy frames them as 'woven baskets, ideal for all your home decor and storage needs' - genuinely ambiguous between decorative accent basket and functional storage per storage.md Sec.5/23/42, so recorded with confidence=LOW and a review flag rather than being silently excluded or force-included as HIGH. No other storage/organization category (boxes, bins, organizers, shelving with product coverage, racks, closet/wardrobe storage, laundry storage) exists anywhere in the mega-menu or the full sitemap scan. As expected for a fabric/textile-design boutique, the site skews heavily Textile (24 rows) with a single low-confidence Storage candidate (1 row).
